message.isekai_mahou.structure_hint.mage: Books, crystals and a hostile presence at the top of the tower. The Renegade Archmage still guards his secrets.
message.isekai_mahou.structure_hint.witc: The cauldron is still bubbling. Recipe pages and a corrupted witch wait inside.
message.isekai_mahou.structure_hint.prof: The chalk circle pulses with blood: a Patron is imprisoned here. Freeing it may be a mistake... or a pact.
message.isekai_mahou.structure_hint.drui: The ancient stones guard an ancestral sapling. Half of the circle rots under an Ent's corruption.
message.isekai_mahou.structure_hint.forg: The stairs lead down into darkness. Sealed sarcophagi, restless souls and a Lich at the bottom of the crypt.
message.isekai_mahou.structure_hint.arca: Remains of an old magic circle. Search the stones for glyph scrolls and mana crystals.
message.isekai_mahou.structure_hint.wand: A wandering mage rests here. Maybe he has something to trade.
message.isekai_mahou.structure_hint.fair: Glowing flowers, fireflies at night and fairy laughter over the water.
book.isekai_mahou.archmage_journal.page1:
Day 1.

The Council rejected my thesis on the forbidden glyphs. Cowards.

I raised this tower far from them, where the mana lines cross beneath the earth.
book.isekai_mahou.archmage_journal.page2:
Glyphs are not words: they are doors.

Every Form, every Effect, every Augment opens a crack into the aether. Whoever masters the right order masters the world itself.
book.isekai_mahou.archmage_journal.page3:
I studied at the Research Table downstairs until the notes burned in my hands.

The sanctum circle already answers my call... but it demands its price in blood.
book.isekai_mahou.archmage_journal.page4:
If you are reading this, I am no longer myself.

Do not climb to the sanctum unprepared. What remains of Valdris will not let you leave.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.mage_tower.desc: A tower raised over a crossing of mana lines; the Archmage's magic still hums in its walls. Observe from inside the tower.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.witch_hut_ancien: Centuries of potion fumes soaked into the wood. Water and Shadow mixed in the cauldron. Observe from inside the hut.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.profane_altar.de: A chalk circle activated with blood holds something not of this world. Observe inside the ruins.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.druid_circle.des: Menhirs that channel the life of the forest, half of them taken by corruption. Observe inside the circle.
Souls trapped between Light and Shadow, far from the sun. Observe inside the crypt.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.arcane_ruins.des: Remains of an ancient magic circle; residual mana still gathers into crystals. Observe inside the ruins.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.wandering_mage_c: A travelling mage's campfire keeps sparks of simple spells. Observe at the camp.
phenomenon.isekai_mahou.fairy_lake.desc: Still water where fairy light is reflected. Observe at the lakeshore.
